Cap Cana is a gated 30,000-acre community inside the Punta Cana region, 10–15 minutes from Punta Cana International Airport, with the Punta Espada and Las Iguanas golf courses, private beach clubs and the marina. For a group, Villa Espada is a private 6- or 8-bedroom villa on Fairway 5 of Punta Espada with a private chef, butler, housekeeping, airport transfers and two golf carts included; in peak season, 16 guests pay about $250 per person per night.

Yes. Four families of four fit in the full 8-bedroom estate with two en-suite bedrooms each: parents in one (twin-XL pairs join into kings) and children in the other (twin-XL beds split apart, or the two queens in a streetside room).
